ORGANIC GROCERY IDENTITY

Fresh food, packed with care. A warm and friendly logo concept for an organic grocery brand.

↓

THE BIG IDEA

Market freshness, packed into one bold mark.

The crate communicates trust and farm-to-home delivery. Simple vegetable shapes add freshness and energy, while the rounded letterforms keep the brand approachable for everyday shoppers.

See the full logo system
→

LOGO ANATOMY

Friendly by shape. Fresh by color.
01
Wooden crate

A strong, simple container that signals local produce, honest sourcing and careful delivery.

02
Vegetable crown

Leaf, tomato and carrot silhouettes stay readable even when the logo is used at a small size.

03
Rounded wordmark

A bold, soft type style balances the rustic icon with a modern and welcoming personality.

LOGO SYSTEM

One crate. Three useful forms.

Use the horizontal logo for storefronts, the stacked logo for packaging, and the icon for apps or social profiles.
